## Screen: 47863818-0748-4226-9349-39428c1d3140

- **Platform**: ios
- **Thumbnail URL**: https://images.refero.design/screenshots/5/mobile/464fd362-ba76-4c29-84f9-34cf646c86ad_thumb.jpg
- **ReferoURL**: https://refero.design/screens/47863818-0748-4226-9349-39428c1d3140
- **Page Types**: Profile & Account, Settings
- **UI Elements**: List, Button, Switch & Toggle
- **Colors**: 0xBCC266, 0x44C39B, 0x3A3DBC, 0xC12085, 0xC6A2E1

### Content
- **Description**: The screen is a mobile app settings interface with a white background and a simple, clean layout. At the top, there is a navigation bar with a grey 'Settings' title centered and a blue 'DONE' button on the right. Below the header, there are three horizontally elongated rounded rectangular buttons labeled 'HELP CENTER', 'FEEDBACK', and 'SIGN OUT' in uppercase blue text, spaced vertically with subtle shadows or borders. The screen is divided into two main sections: 'General' and 'Super Duolingo'. The 'General' section features a list of five settings items: 'Sound effects', 'Haptic feedback', 'Motivational messages', 'Speaking exercises', and 'Listening exercises'. Each item is aligned left with a switch toggle on the right side. Four toggles are switched on (blue) and one ('Speaking exercises') is off (grey). The toggles are standard iOS style with blue fill and white circular thumb. The 'Super Duolingo' section contains two similarly styled buttons labeled 'MANAGE SUBSCRIPTION' and 'RESTORE PURCHASES' in uppercase blue text. The typography uses a bold, rounded sans-serif font for section headers ('General', 'Super Duolingo') in dark grey, and a clean, monospaced or slab serif style font for list items in black or dark grey. The layout is vertically scrollable with consistent padding and spacing between elements. The overall style is minimalistic, user-friendly, and functional, emphasizing clarity and ease of interaction.
- **Layout**: The layout is a single-column vertical scroll with three main grouped sections. The top section contains three full-width rounded rectangular buttons stacked vertically with equal spacing. Below is the 'General' section with a bold header aligned left, followed by a rounded rectangular container with five rows. Each row has left-aligned text and a right-aligned toggle switch, separated by subtle horizontal dividers. The toggles are aligned consistently on the right edge. The last section labeled 'Super Duolingo' has a bold header and two full-width rounded rectangular buttons stacked vertically with spacing matching the top buttons. The entire screen uses consistent horizontal padding and vertical margins between sections and elements. The navigation bar at the top is fixed with the title centered and action button on the right. The bottom has a small safe area margin. The design uses whitespace effectively to separate functional areas and maintain readability.
- **Functions**: Users can perform several actions on this settings screen. They can tap the 'HELP CENTER' button to access support resources, tap 'FEEDBACK' to provide input or report issues, and tap 'SIGN OUT' to log out of their account. In the 'General' section, users can enable or disable individual app features by toggling switches for sound effects, haptic feedback, motivational messages, speaking exercises, and listening exercises. This allows customization of the app experience. In the 'Super Duolingo' section, users can manage their subscription plan or restore previous purchases, facilitating account and payment management. The screen supports efficient navigation and clear control over preferences, helping users personalize their app usage and access support or account options easily.

## Screen: 7f9cd6c0-640d-484a-b34b-f55218b0561f

- **Platform**: ios

- **UX Patterns**: Article & Text, Tutorial & Education
- **UI Elements**: Button, Step Indicator, Progress Bar, Navigation Bar, Icon, Illustration, Hero Image
- **Colors**: 0x070707, 0x636464, 0xEAAF28, 0x2EA388, 0xA25C1E

### Content
- **Description**: The screen features a clean, minimalist design with a white background. At the top left, there is a close (X) icon, and to the right, a progress indicator consisting of four circles with the first three filled in gray and the fourth in light gray, accompanied by a yellow lightning bolt icon on the far right. Below this header area, a colorful flat illustration of a gray mug with an orange lid labeled 'NEW HAMPSHIRE' and decorated with mountain graphics is centered. Beneath the illustration, a bold, large black heading reads 'Analyzing Bar Charts' in a sans-serif font. Below the heading is a smaller paragraph of black body text explaining the topic: 'Bar charts are one of the most common ways to display data — let's make sure they're as easy as possible to analyze.' At the bottom of the screen is a large black rounded rectangular button with white text labeled 'Continue.' The layout is vertically stacked with generous white space, centered alignment, and a modern, friendly style with simple vector illustration and clear typography. The font is consistent and legible, likely a system sans-serif with a bold weight for the heading and regular for the paragraph. The button is full width with comfortable padding and rounded corners, providing a clear call to action. The overall style is instructional and welcoming, suitable for an educational or onboarding flow.
- **Layout**: The layout is a single-column vertical stack centered horizontally. At the top is a header area with the close icon on the left, a horizontal progress indicator composed of four circles in the center, and a lightning bolt icon on the right. Below the header is a large centered illustration occupying roughly the upper third of the screen. Under the illustration is the main textual content: a bold heading followed by a descriptive paragraph, both center-aligned. The bottom area contains a full-width rounded rectangular button with the label 'Continue.' The layout uses generous vertical spacing between elements, with consistent horizontal padding ensuring content does not touch screen edges. The design is clean and uncluttered, focusing user attention sequentially from top to bottom.
- **Functions**: Users can read and understand the introductory information about analyzing bar charts presented on this screen. The close (X) icon allows users to exit or dismiss the tutorial or onboarding flow at any time. The progress indicator visually informs users about their current step within a multi-step process, helping them track their progress. The 'Continue' button enables users to proceed to the next step or screen in the tutorial or onboarding sequence. This screen supports the broader goal of educating users on data visualization concepts, specifically bar charts, by providing clear, concise information with supportive visuals and intuitive navigation cues. The design ensures ease of comprehension and smooth progression through the learning material, enhancing user engagement and retention.

## Screen: a576c74f-bd8d-4ce1-9ad0-122fe535e084

- **Platform**: ios
- **Thumbnail URL**: https://images.refero.design/screenshots/188/mobile/3b86f736-fc03-41ee-82b0-a5a23ca1d669_thumb.jpg
- **ReferoURL**: https://refero.design/screens/a576c74f-bd8d-4ce1-9ad0-122fe535e084
- **Page Types**: Discover
- **UX Patterns**: Select
- **UI Elements**: Cards & Tiles, Carousel, Button, Tags & Chips, Icon, Illustration, Thumbnail, Tabbar
- **Colors**: 0xA35740, 0x281011, 0xD8A24A, 0x4B70DC, 0x4DB3E4

### Content
- **Description**: This screen is a mobile interface for browsing an educational course catalog. The background is white (#FFFFFF) with a clean, modern sans-serif font in dark gray (#1A1A1A) for headings and lighter gray (#7A7A7A) for subtext. The top section features a bold, large heading 'Explore All 120+ Courses' centered horizontally, using a heavy font weight around 24pt. Below it is a horizontal scrollable tab bar with pill-shaped tabs labeled with categories such as 'Philosophy', 'Money & Career', 'More', and 'Search'. The 'More' tab is highlighted with a blue (#007AFF) border and text, while others have a light gray border and dark text. The section below has a subheading 'More' in bold, followed by a smaller heading 'Science & Tech'. A grid of four course cards is displayed in two columns and two rows, each card with rounded corners and a thin blue border matching the highlight color. Each card contains a colorful, stylized illustration relevant to the course topic, with the course title in bold black text beneath and the author name in smaller gray text below that. The bottom navigation bar has four icons with labels: Home, Courses (highlighted in blue), Library, and Saved, all aligned horizontally with equal spacing. The overall layout is a vertical scroll with consistent padding and margin, using a 2-column grid for course cards, and a horizontal scroll for category tabs. The style is minimalistic and user-friendly with a focus on easy navigation and content discovery.
- **Layout**: The layout consists of a vertical stack with three main sections: category tabs at the top, course listings in the middle, and a bottom navigation bar. The category tabs are arranged horizontally in a scrollable container with pill-shaped buttons spaced evenly. Below, the course listings are arranged in a 2-column grid with two rows visible, each item containing an image and text stacked vertically. The bottom navigation bar is a horizontal row of four equally spaced icon-label pairs, fixed at the bottom. Padding and margins are consistent, with rounded corners on cards and tabs. The layout uses a clean, grid-based approach to organize content and navigation elements for clarity and ease of use.
- **Functions**: Users can browse and explore a variety of educational courses by selecting categories from the horizontal tab bar at the top. The active tab is visually distinct to provide clear navigation context. Users can scroll vertically to view the course offerings within the selected category. Each course card is clickable, allowing users to view more details or enroll in the course. The bottom navigation bar facilitates quick switching between main app sections: Home, Courses, Library, and Saved courses. The interface supports efficient discovery of new courses by category and featured lists, encouraging exploration and learning. Overall, the screen helps users find and select courses of interest from a large catalog, enhancing educational engagement.

## Screen: aa871eca-62d2-4e49-bbf2-0ce2c16bd879

- **Platform**: ios
- **Thumbnail URL**: https://images.refero.design/screenshots/5/mobile/bb4fc3fe-d3b4-492e-b668-f7bc3f32241a_thumb.jpg
- **ReferoURL**: https://refero.design/screens/aa871eca-62d2-4e49-bbf2-0ce2c16bd879
- **UX Patterns**: Success, Stats
- **UI Elements**: Cards & Tiles, Button, Illustration
- **Colors**: 0xC5BFA3, 0x45C0A0, 0xC92595, 0x4645C2, 0xC5A627

### Content
- **Description**: The screen is a lesson completion interface from an educational or language learning app. The background is solid white (#FFFFFF) with colorful cartoon-style characters centered near the top: a green owl mascot on the left and a person with a yellow headband and blue pants on the right, both animated in a playful style. Below them, the bold heading 'Lesson complete!' is displayed in a large, rounded, yellow font (approximate color #FFB800) with friendly and inviting typography. Underneath are three horizontally aligned rectangular cards with rounded corners, each containing a label and a corresponding icon with a value: 'TOTAL XP' in white text on a yellow background (#FFC107) with a lightning bolt icon and the number 13; 'QUICK' in white text on a blue background (#2196F3) with a stopwatch icon and time 3:15; and 'GREAT' in white text on a green background (#4CAF50) with a target icon and percentage 90%. The cards have white backgrounds with colored borders matching their accent colors, and the text and icons inside share the same accent colors. At the bottom center, a large blue (#2196F3) rounded rectangular button labeled 'CONTINUE' in white uppercase text invites the user to proceed. The layout is clean and vertically centered with ample white space, using bright and saturated colors to create a cheerful, rewarding atmosphere. The font is rounded and friendly, consistent with educational apps for children or casual learners. The status bar at the top is minimal with time, signal, Wi-Fi, and battery icons.
- **Layout**: The layout is vertically centered with three main horizontal sections: top with mascot characters spaced apart, middle with a bold heading, and bottom with three equally sized metric cards aligned horizontally with consistent spacing. Below the cards is a wide rectangular button centered horizontally. The screen uses a single-column layout with elements stacked vertically and horizontally grouped cards. Padding is generous around all elements to create breathing room. The cards have consistent size and shape with rounded corners. The button spans nearly full width with symmetrical horizontal margins. The overall alignment is centered with balanced white space above and below.
- **Functions**: Users can view their lesson completion status, including total experience points earned (XP), time taken to complete the lesson (Quick), and performance accuracy (Great). The UI elements such as the colored cards visually summarize key metrics with icons and numbers to provide clear feedback on performance. The 'CONTINUE' button allows users to proceed to the next lesson or screen, supporting smooth navigation. The screen serves to motivate and reward users by celebrating lesson completion and showing progress indicators. The playful characters and bright colors enhance user engagement and satisfaction. Overall, the screen facilitates recognition of achievement and encourages continued learning by providing immediate feedback and a clear call to action.

## Screen: b489253b-897f-46b2-a97b-351929697587

- **Platform**: ios
- **Thumbnail URL**: https://images.refero.design/screenshots/5/mobile/61718733-3e42-4660-abf0-cc64e507872a_thumb.jpg
- **ReferoURL**: https://refero.design/screens/b489253b-897f-46b2-a97b-351929697587
- **UX Patterns**: Achievements & Awards
- **UI Elements**: Button, Tabs, Progress Bar, Icon, Illustration
- **Colors**: 0xC18AA1, 0x44C6A8, 0x423FB9, 0xC32080, 0xC0A21E

### Content
- **Description**: The screen is a mobile app interface with a purple header containing two tabs: "QUESTS" (active) and "BADGES" (inactive). The header includes a small Duolingo owl mascot on the right side and a short description text encouraging users to complete quests daily for rewards. Below the header, the main content area has a white background and is divided into sections. The first section titled "Friends Quest" contains a rounded rectangular card with a message stating no friends are available for the quest this week, alongside a prominent blue button labeled "+ ADD FRIENDS" with a user-plus icon. The next section is labeled "Daily Quest" with a small orange clock icon and "6 HOURS" text indicating time remaining. It includes a quest card showing "Earn 10 XP" with a yellow progress bar filled 10/10 and a locked chest icon at the end. Below is a disabled quest card with a lock icon and text "More quests unlock soon" in grey. The bottom of the screen has a horizontal navigation bar with six colorful icons: a birdhouse, dumbbells, a chest (highlighted with a blue border), a shield, a smiling face with a notification dot, and a bell. The typography uses a rounded sans-serif font, with bold titles and smaller descriptive text. The color palette includes purple (#9B7DD9 approx) for the header, white for the background, blue (#00A1FF approx) for the add friends button, yellow (#FFCC00 approx) for progress bars, orange (#FF8000 approx) for time indicators, and grey for disabled text. The layout is vertically stacked with clear padding and rounded corners for cards. The style is playful and friendly, consistent with gamification and educational apps.
- **Layout**: The screen layout is a single-column vertical stack. At the top is a fixed-height header with two horizontally arranged tabs spaced apart: "QUESTS" aligned left and "BADGES" aligned right, with an underline below the active tab. Below the header is a short descriptive text aligned left and an illustration aligned right. The main content area contains two main sections, each with a heading and one or more cards stacked vertically with spacing. Cards have rounded corners and padding inside. The bottom navigation bar is a horizontal row with six equally spaced icons, centered horizontally at the bottom of the screen. The overall layout uses generous vertical spacing and padding for clarity and touch friendliness, with alignment mostly left for text and centered for icons. The design uses consistent margins and rounded corners to create a cohesive friendly interface.
- **Functions**: Users can switch between the "Quests" and "Badges" tabs to view different types of achievements. In the "Friends Quest" section, users are informed if they have no friends available for the quest and can tap the "+ ADD FRIENDS" button to invite or add friends, facilitating social engagement. The "Daily Quest" section allows users to track their progress towards earning experience points (XP) with a visual progress bar and a time indicator showing when the quest will refresh or expire. Locked quests provide feedback on upcoming content. The bottom navigation bar enables users to quickly access different app sections, with the current section highlighted. Overall, the screen guides users to complete and monitor quests to earn rewards, encouraging daily interaction and social connectivity within the app.

### Content
- **Description**: This mobile screen features a clean, minimalistic design with a white background and subtle orange accents. At the top, bold black text reads 'For you,' indicating personalized content. Below this is a horizontal week-day selector with circular icons representing days, where Tuesday is highlighted in bright lime green (#C7E000) with a black lightning bolt icon, and other days are greyed out. On the right side, a lime green pill-shaped badge with '1' and a lightning bolt icon is displayed. The main content area shows a card with a light orange background (#FFE6CC) and rounded corners. The card includes a small illustrated icon of a notebook with data analysis graphics, the text 'DATA ANALYSIS' in uppercase orange (#D2691E) bold font, and a subtitle 'Exploring Data Visually' in black regular font. Centered below is a 3D-style orange stack icon with a green marker above it. At the bottom of the card is a white pill-shaped button with black text 'Analyzing Bar Charts.' Below the card are four pagination dots, with the first dot filled dark grey and the others light grey, indicating multiple cards. The bottom navigation bar has four icons: Home (active, black), Courses (greyed out), Leagues (greyed out with a red notification dot), and Settings (greyed out). The overall typography uses a bold sans-serif font for headings and regular weight for subtitles and labels. The layout is vertically stacked with clear spacing and alignment, emphasizing clarity and ease of navigation.
- **Layout**: The layout is a vertically stacked single-column design. At the top, a horizontal row contains the 'For you' title on the left and a pill-shaped badge on the right. Below that, a horizontal row of 5 circular day selectors spaced evenly with the first day highlighted. The main content area features a large rectangular card with rounded corners and padding, centered horizontally. The card includes an icon and text aligned top-left, a central 3D icon, and a bottom-centered button. Below the card is a horizontal pagination indicator with 4 dots spaced evenly. The bottom of the screen contains a fixed horizontal navigation bar with 4 equally spaced icon buttons. The layout uses generous white space, consistent margins, and alignment for clarity and touch accessibility.
- **Functions**: Users can view personalized learning content tailored for them, indicated by the 'For you' heading. They can select different days of the week using the circular day selectors to filter or view content relevant to that day. The highlighted day and badge provide visual feedback on the current selection or progress. The main card presents a specific learning module on data analysis, including a title, subtitle, and an illustrative icon to engage users visually. The button labeled 'Analyzing Bar Charts' likely allows users to start or continue this lesson. Pagination dots below the card indicate multiple modules users can swipe through. The bottom navigation bar enables users to switch between main app sections: Home, Courses, Leagues (with notifications), and Settings. The red dot on Leagues signals new activity or alerts. Overall, the screen supports browsing educational content, tracking progress, and navigating the app efficiently.

- **Platform**: ios

- **Colors**: 0xC3A8B9, 0x44BEA5, 0xCB2687, 0x443EBF, 0xC1A922

### Content
- **Description**: This screen is a user profile page displaying detailed user statistics and social metrics. The top section includes a back arrow icon on the left and a 'SUPER' badge on the right. The username 'daniela' is shown in bold dark gray (#3a3a3a) with the handle 'danielitanina' below in a lighter gray (#7a7a7a). The join date is indicated in smaller gray text. Below the username are multiple colorful flag icons representing languages or countries, followed by blue clickable text links for '5 Following' and '16 Followers'. There is a large rounded rectangular button labeled 'FOLLOWING' in bright green (#4caf50) with a user-check icon, and a smaller square share button with an upward arrow icon in blue (#2196f3). To the right of the username is a circular avatar photo with a red background. The middle section is titled 'XP this week' in bold dark gray, followed by a rounded rectangular card containing a line chart with two lines: a solid blue line with circular data points representing 'daniela' and a gray line representing 'You'. The chart's horizontal axis shows days abbreviated as T, F, S, S, M, T, W. At the top right inside the chart is the total XP for 'daniela' (229 XP) in blue and 'You' (32 XP) in gray. Below is the 'Statistics' section with a grid of cards: a large yellow card with a flame icon and '510 Day streak', a white card with a lightning bolt icon and '105668 Total XP', and additional cards partially visible including 'Obsidian Current league' with a dark gem icon and a 'Week 3' badge, and '25 Top 3 finishes' with a gold coin icon. The overall style is clean, modern, and friendly with a white background (#ffffff), rounded corners on cards and buttons, and consistent use of blue (#2196f3) for interactive text and icons. The typography uses a bold sans-serif font for headings and buttons, and lighter weights for secondary text. The layout is vertically scrollable with clear separation between sections and ample white space for readability.
- **Layout**: The layout is vertically stacked with a single column format. The top section includes a horizontally aligned row with a back arrow on the far left, username and details centered-left, and a 'SUPER' badge plus circular avatar aligned to the right. Below is a horizontal row of flag icons and follower/following links. The 'FOLLOWING' button and share icon are placed side by side horizontally with spacing. The XP graph is contained within a rounded rectangular card with padding and margin separating it from other content. The statistics section uses a grid layout with two columns and multiple rows, each card having rounded corners and consistent spacing. The layout uses generous vertical padding between sections and horizontal padding inside cards and buttons, ensuring clarity and touch-friendly targets. Visual hierarchy is maintained with bold headings and color-coded elements. The entire screen uses a white background with subtle shadows or border outlines on cards and buttons to create depth.
- **Functions**: Users can view detailed profile information including username, join date, and avatar. They can see the number of users they follow and their followers, and interact with the 'FOLLOWING' button to manage their follow status. The share button allows users to share the profile or related content. The XP graph visually compares the user's weekly experience points against another user ('daniela'), helping users track progress over time. Users can analyze their activity patterns and engagement through the line chart. The statistics section provides quick insights into achievements like day streaks, total XP, league status, and top finishes, motivating continued participation. Overall, the interface facilitates social engagement, progress tracking, and gamified motivation by presenting clear, interactive data and profile details in an accessible manner.
